description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing an interface for shared, process-wide cyclic buffer management, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class for managing a shared, process-wide cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration functionalities.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A helper class for peeking into the buffer at specific positions, managing offsets, and calculating tail positions.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method to notify when data becomes available in the buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting until data is present.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Reads data non-destructively from the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and consumes data from the buffer.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for upcoming writes.
